product.name: Monoprice Caliber In-Ceiling Speakers 8in Fiber 2-Way (pair)
product.description: In‑ceiling speakers have revolutionized the way we experience audio in our homes, offering a seamless integration of high‑fidelity sound without sacrificing valuable living space. Say goodbye to cumbersome box speakers and welcome the Monoprice Caliber In‑Ceiling Speakers Fiber 2‑Way (pair) into your home audio setup. These remarkable speakers not only deliver exceptional sound quality but also blend effortlessly with your interior decor.One of the standout features of the Caliber series is its removable and paintable grille, allowing you to customize the speakers to match your unique style. With a uniform sound stage across your entire listening area, these in‑ceiling speakers ensure that every corner of your home is filled with immersive audio. Whether you have a simple two‑channel listening room or a full‑fledged home theater with advanced audio technologies like 7.2.4 Atmos or DTS:X, the Caliber series is designed to complement your system with its perfectly matched components.The Caliber In‑Ceiling Speakers feature an Aramid Fiber Cone Driver, renowned for its lightweight construction, rigidity, and strength. This unique driver design delivers clean and accurate bass reproduction, allowing you to experience the full depth and richness of your music or movie soundtracks. Unlike conventional drivers, the aramid fiber cone minimizes distortion, ensuring a natural and immersive audio experience.Complementing the impressive bass response, the Caliber speakers are equipped with Titanium Silk Dome Tweeters. The titanium silk construction offers excellent projection and warm tones, resulting in a well‑rounded audio performance. Whether you're enjoying your favorite music or watching a movie, these pivoting tweeters provide detailed clarity, defined vocals, and dialogues that bring your entertainment to life.Versatility is another key aspect of the Caliber series. These speakers can serve as exceptional main home theater speakers, effortlessly filling your space with captivating sound. Alternatively, you can incorporate them into whole‑home sound systems, allowing you to enjoy synchronized audio in every room. If you have an immersive sound system, the Caliber speakers make excellent surround sound additions, further enhancing the cinematic experience.Upgrade your home audio with the Monoprice Caliber In‑Ceiling Speakers Fiber 2‑Way (pair) and rediscover the joy of immersive sound without sacrificing your living space. With their sonically matched components, customizable grilles, and impressive performance, these speakers are a perfect blend of functionality and aesthetics. Immerse yourself in audio bliss and elevate your home entertainment experience with the Caliber series. Aramid Fiber Cone DriverTitanium Silk Dome TweetersVersatileAramid Fiber Cone Driver: Aramid fiber is very light, rigid, and strong and delivers clean bass reproduction. This lightweight transducer produces a natural sound with significantly less distortion than conventional drivers.Titanium Silk Dome Tweeters: Titanium silk offers good projection with warm tones. Immerse yourself in airy, detailed clarity with defined vocals and dialog from the pivoting titanium silk dome tweeters of these speakers.Versatile: Enjoy Caliber™ series speakers as main home theater speakers, for whole home sound systems, or add them as surrounds in immersive sound systems.  Features Light and rigid, well balanced, yellow woven aramid fiber cone woofers for distortion‑free reproductionOversized magnets for more impactful bassPrecision titanium silk membrane dome tweeters for sweeter highs and pure sonic clarityPivoting tweeters allow you to point the acoustics to the prime listening position for a more accurate and immersive sonic experienceAdjustable crossover switch allows you to match the speakers to the sonic characteristics of your listening environment and the location in which you place them60 watts nominal and 120 watts maximum power handling capacity8 ohms nominal impedance ensure they can be safely driven by even the most modest home theater receivers What's in the box?2x 6.5" 2‑way in‑ceiling speaker with grille1x Installation instructions1x Cutout template and paint mask1x Grille removal tool1x Grille putty Tools Recommended for Installation Stud finderCarpenter's levelMarking pen or pencilDrywall cutter14AWG CL2 in‑wall rated speaker wire (P/N 16083)Wire strippersPhillips screwdriver.gte-ctr .row{margin:0;}1 Year Replacement WarrantyMonoprice™ not only stands behind every product we sell with a 1 year replacement warranty, we offer a 30 day money back guarantee as well!
